Population: Australian specialist tactical police selection candidates
Participant_Flow: 18 male candidates started; 11 completed; 2 self-withdrew; 5 medically withdrawn
Completer_Results: Body mass −2.05 kg, p=0.006; right grip −14.48 kg, p<0.001; left grip −14.27 kg, p<0.001; sit-and-reach −6.64 cm, p<0.001
Null_or_Nonsignificant_Results: Power output, peak jump velocity and vertical jump height did not show statistically significant deterioration.
Permitted_Claim: Acute within-course changes among completers only.
Prohibited_Inference: Injury causation; selection-success prediction; readiness determination; optimal course design; universal tactical effect; long-term effect; Brazil-direct application.
